ESDS Software Shares Surge Post-IPO, Hit Upper Circuit

ESDS Software Solution's shares experienced a significant surge following its Initial Public Offering (IPO), hitting a 20% upper circuit and reaching ₹1,090.05. The stock has risen 155% against its issue price within two days of its listing. While the strong performance has generated investor excitement, financial experts are advising caution, recommending profit booking and monitoring for potential market corrections before making further investment decisions.
